name: How long does a car accident claim take to resolve?
description: Resolution time varies, from a few months for simple cases to over a year for complex ones, depending on injury severity and negotiations.

mainEntity.name: How long does a car accident claim take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a car accident claim varies significantly based on factors such as the complexity of the accident, the severity of injuries, the willingness of insurance companies to negotiate, and court schedules if a lawsuit is filed. Simple cases might resolve in a few months, while more complex ones involving significant injuries or disputes could take a year or more.
